judgments.reason: The passage states in Figure 2(a) that the core ChauffeurNet model consists of a FeatureNet and an AgentRNN.
The passage states in Figure 2(b) that there is a co-trained road mask prediction net and PerceptionRNN.
The passage says that training losses are shown in blue and green labels depict the ground-truth data.
The passage states that the dashed arrows represent the recurrent feedback of predictions from one iteration to the next.
The passage says 'lights and dynamic objects are sampled over the past Tscene seconds, while the past agent poses are sampled over a potentially longer interval of Tpose seconds.'
The passage states that the box representation of other dynamic objects makes it easy to generate input data from simulation or real-sensor logs using a standard perception system.
The passage says this input representation enables testing and validation of models in closed-loop simulations before running them on a real car.
